about_the_game:
The Singularity fractured the world. Now, survivors rebuild among its ruins while machines and twisted mutants battle to shape what's left.

Singularity Divide is a post-apocalyptic RTS where you're more than just a commander, you're the last thread holding humanity together. Build from scavenged ruins. Manage survivors with unique stats. And decide who you’ll trust: the evolving AI networks offering stability… or the mutated remnants whispering rebirth. Or will you forge a new path?

Features:

  • Base building from the bones of the old world — convert ruins into greenhouses, watchtowers, and survivor havens.

  • Choices Matter — your decisions shape your tech tree, units, and narrative path.

  • Emergent AI & Mutant threats — the more you grow, the more they notice.

  • Procedural world generation — every run brings new ruins, new layouts, and new dilemmas.

  • Combat, strategy, and survival — it's not just about winning. It's about what you're becoming to do it.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains stylized violence, survival scenarios, and thematic elements related to societal collapse and mutant/AI conflict.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 / AMD FX-8320
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

Recommended:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
